notes: The Recovery Academy tutorial got a full personality pass: every mentor now has a name and voice, each lesson opens and closes with an in-character line, finishing a lesson triggers a small gold celebration instead of just moving on, and lessons now fade smoothly into one another instead of cutting instantly. Also gave Renewed Faith its own dedicated card art instead of a placeholder.
fixes: Renewed Faith (JD-012) was missing dedicated card art and was silently falling back to a generic placeholder image everywhere it appeared. It now has its own artwork matching the rest of the Hope class.
features: The Recovery Academy tutorial's 11 lessons now have named mentors (Dawn, Marcus, Priya, Theo, and Dean Alvarez) with a consistent voice and running through-line, an in-character opening and closing line for every lesson, a small gold celebration beat when you complete a lesson, and a smooth fade between lessons instead of an instant cut.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
